findings.title: Routed flow against diffusion
findings.claim: Alongside a contrast between giving and excessive quantity of spending, the attributed reading follows resources routed to claim-bearing destinations versus dispersion that loses destination, fit, and restorative function.

findings.reader_payoff: The positive command reads as destination-bound circulation rather than simple spending, and the prohibition as loss of direction.
findings.containment: This legacy_unbound model is exploratory and attributed; water channels, sockets, stillness, and seeds are analogies, not literal objects in the verse.
